yt_posts.topic: Pieverse touches a $1 billion market cap on a red day: how the call went and the four payments lanes moving on-chain (Zelle and Solana, Swift and Consensys, DTCC and Canton, AI agents)
yt_posts.body_style: stat shock, the call, the four lanes, one caveat line, the comment ask
yt_posts.body:
Pieverse touched a $1 billion market cap on November 18. It ran 70% in a single day while Bitcoin fell 3% and most of the top 100 was red. I called it a year ago near a $60 million market cap, and the reason it's moving is bigger than one coin.

First, the numbers. $PIEVERSE printed a new all-time high around $3.60 and finished the day as the biggest gainer in the top 100. It's up around 118% on the week. Bitcoin is down around 15% over the same week.

Here's how the call went. My bot flagged it in November 2025, down near a $20 million market cap. It ran, I waited, it came back down, and I bought near $60 million. I didn't talk about it publicly until September.

Now the part that matters: why. Pieverse trades in the agent payments narrative, the x402 trade. And payments isn't one narrative anymore. It's four lanes, and every one of them is moving on-chain.

Lane one, bank to bank. Zelle just picked Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and its push into international payments.

Lane two, wires. Swift is building its blockchain ledger with Consensys, the team that built Linea, and it has been in a live pilot with 17 banks since July.

Lane three, settlement. The DTCC put its tokenization service live on Canton, with Solana lined up for the second half of 2027.

Lane four, machines. AI agents that pay each other. That's the lane Pieverse sits in. Here's the thing: what's live from Pieverse right now is its AI agents for chat apps. The payment rails are still ahead, and that's the part the market is betting on.

So would I chase a 70% day? No. It's dangerous up here. The time to get in is at the bottom, way down at the bottom, when nobody is looking. That's why I keep a play in every one of these lanes.

So tell me: which payments lane ends up the biggest? Bank transfers, settlement, or AI agents? Drop it in the comments.

If this helped you see the payments narrative, hit like and subscribe so you catch the next one.

yt_posts.topic: Every coin gets its day: the bull run is arriving one coin at a time (Quant, NEAR, Pieverse, LAB), when everything pumps together, and where that leaves Kaspa
yt_posts.body_style: viewer question, the evidence chain, the macro path, the Kaspa setup, the comment ask
yt_posts.body:
Somebody told me this week that Kaspa will lead the next bull run. Here's my answer: the run isn't showing up as one big green month where everything goes up together. Not yet. It's showing up one coin at a time, and it already started.

Look at the last three months. Quant went from around $56 on August 19 to around $287 on October 1. That's 5x in six weeks. NEAR went from around $1.59 to around $5.89 by October 12, almost 4x. Then this week Pieverse ran 70% in a day and touched a $1 billion market cap, in a week when Bitcoin dropped around 15%.

None of them waited for Bitcoin. Each one had its own narrative and its own day: Quant in bank settlement, Pieverse in agent payments. It was the same with LAB. I called that one thinking 20x over a couple of years. In May it exploded and we did 353x. You never know which one is next, or when. Solana might get its big run next year while TAO waits for the year after. It could go something like that.

So when does everything pump at the same time? I think that comes later. Energy prices are finally coming down: US oil just fell under $83 a barrel for the first time since late August. When prices keep coming down, the Fed gets room to cut, and cheap money is what lifts everything at once. A week or two like that in 2027? Possible. The real thing, where the whole market flies together, I think that's more like 2028.

Where does that leave Kaspa? $KAS is sitting around 2.7 cents, 87% under its all-time high. Same proof of work, same fair launch, same 10 blocks per second. Its day hasn't come yet. And that's the setup I want for any high conviction play: get in at the bottom, way down at the bottom, before its day. If you're aiming for a 50x and it only does a 5x, you still did a 5x.

So tell me: when does Kaspa get its run? First half of 2027, second half of 2027, or 2028? Drop it in the comments.

If this changed how you think about the next bull run, hit like and subscribe for more.
